      How the upgrade rehearsal worksDeclare, run, and share a receipt
      
        01Declare the pathName both versions, supported systems, resource minimums, schemas, and hook commands.
        02Run the test commandsThe CLI uses a new temporary directory for sample data, backup, restore, and health checks.
        03Give customers the receiptShare the HTML receipt. Keep the JSON receipt as your release gate.

        Download linux-x86_64.tar.gz

        curl -fsSL https://selfhost-upgrade-rehearsal.sociobot.in/install.sh | sh

      First runrehearsal init compose
# edit rehearsal.yml
rehearsal check
rehearsal run --output release-proof
    

    
      Receipt limitsKnow what the receipt does not prove
      
        It does not connect to customer servers or collect customer data.
        It does not upgrade a customer installation.
        Each receipt covers only its listed versions and environments.
